required_patterns.styling: Tailwind CSS with custom color tokens and dynamic design system (e.g., bg-[#1B4332], text-primary)
required_patterns.components: Shadcn UI (Radix UI primitives) placed in components/ui directory

architectural_constraints.accessibility: Must use Radix UI primitives for accessible components
architectural_constraints.class_merging: Must use 'cn' utility from lib/utils.ts for merging Tailwind classes

architectural_constraints.pages: Route entry points must be in page.tsx files
architectural_constraints.layouts: Shared layouts must be in layout.tsx files
architectural_constraints.client_boundaries: Use 'use client' directive at the top of files that use React hooks (useState, etc) or browser APIs

required_patterns.state_management: React useState in a parent component (order-flow.tsx) passed down as props to step components
required_patterns.types: Strictly typed using interfaces/types from lib/order-types.ts

architectural_constraints.component_structure: Step-by-step wizard components separated into discrete files (step-measurements.tsx, step-delivery.tsx, etc.)

architectural_constraints.presentation: Grid layouts using Tailwind CSS grid/flex classes for product listing
